caption: Faction identity reaches the HUD (#1481). Two Spartan spear blocks face two Roman ones; selecting each in turn shows the control-bar formation button, the info panel's Formation line, and its new Faction / Doctrine lines reading in that unit's OWN language -- pyknosis and phalanx for Sparta, acies and scuta undique for the very same two stances on the Roman side. Nothing moves and nobody fights: the readout is the only thing that changes.
